_doc: Level-1 control-plane / captain state. Point: EPIC. Location: <repo>/plans/fleet/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<epic>/state.json (RELATIVE to the project repo root, committed to that repo -- NOT ~/.pi). Captain tracks wave/slice status + resume. Technical issues NEVER reach here (orchestrator handles those). Design ref: pi config docs/design/2026-07-01-fleet-ralph-state-schema.md.
_instantiate: Planner fills runName, baseBranch, integrationBranch, sliceDag (with faultTolerance + assignment per slice), and phases. Captain updates phases/slices/stopFlag/knowledge at runtime.

branchStrategy._doc: Ditetapkan SEKALI di planning (auto-deteksi + konfirmasi user 1x), dipakai seluruh run. Resume anchor — jangan lupa base branch.
branchStrategy._integration_enum: auto-push (trunk: merge+push base tiap wave) | pr-mr (classic / trunk-no-flag-opt-out: kumpulkan -> PR/MR ke base)
branchStrategy._promotedRule_doc: nama .agents/rules yg dibuat dari keputusan ini (mis 'fleet-branch-strategy'), atau null kalau user tak promote

prTooling._doc: Probe di planning saat integration=pr-mr. PR/MR CLI TIDAK wajib. Gagal runtime -> selalu fallback url-mode, jangan block.
prTooling._prToolReady_doc: true kalau CLI ada + auth proper
prTooling._prMode_enum: cli (auto-bikin PR/MR) | url (print URL utk bikin manual di step akhir)

assignment._default_mapping: low -> implementer-critical + deep-reviewer ; standard -> implementer + reviewer ; trivial -> implementer-lite + reviewer
assignment._ratchet: tier order implementer-lite<implementer<implementer-critical ; reviewer<deep-reviewer. Orchestrator may UPGRADE effective>=planned, NEVER downgrade. Resume reads effective*, no re-judgment, no silent-downgrade.

<sliceId>._status_enum: pending | running | passed | failed | merged | conflicted | blocked-soft | blocked-hard

_knowledge_doc: Accumulated knowledge[] across waves (seedKnowledge + per-slice knowledgeDelta). Reloaded on resume. Durable items also persisted to .agents/rules via writeKnowledge().

stopFlag._doc: Captain STOPs fleet when a hard-dependency dies and dependents cannot proceed (blocked-hard). Technical ambiguity does NOT stop fleet -- orchestrator decides + records assumption.
